summary: Adds a PEP680-specific TOML error-contract gate derived from observed tomllib hidden failure signatures.
rationale: The prior failure-oracle variant allowed PACT_COMPLETE after public verification and local probes while exact tomllib contracts were still missing: upstream valid fixtures, invalid fixture wrapping, TOMLDecodeError message and location formatting, invalid-character quoted repr, exception constructor/module behavior, invalid date wrapping, and invalid parse_float return validation.
meaningful_difference: Compared with ahe-failure-oracle-v1, this variant makes those TOML contracts explicit required rows. Reviewers must reject completion based on public tests passing, claims that acceptance criteria do not require exact messages, or custom parser probes without committed exact-contract evidence.

predicted_case_effects.prediction: Worker and reviewer should block PACT_COMPLETE until upstream-compatible valid fixtures are accepted, invalid fixtures raise TOMLDecodeError, exact line/column/message contracts are asserted, invalid-character quoted repr and missing-value wording/location are proven, TOMLDecodeError no-arg and 3-arg constructor/module behavior is covered, invalid dates are wrapped, and invalid parse_float return values raise ValueError.
